paragraphs.text:
You exit your room and make your way to the hotel’s front 
desk. The wiry-looking old woman stands next to the fireplace, 
stoking the coals to keep out the mist’s chill. As you approach 
her, she raises her eyebrows at you inquisitively but says nothing.

You clear your throat and ask her if she saw anyone entering 
or leaving your room, or even just anyone unusual at the hotel. 
She bites her lip for a minute before nodding quickly. She 
grasps your wrist with a fierceness you would not have expected 
of her tiny frame. “The men had guns, I had to give them the keys. 
One of them just left, but the other is still upstairs. I think he’s 
beating that Indian man.” She looks at you nervously, almost 
pleading for you to do something.
• To deal with the man upstairs, go to 142.
• To pursue the man who left, go to 79.
